BiblicalUsage: Siphmoth was a town in the south of Judah, and it appears once, in the list of places to which David sent a share of the spoil he recovered from the Amalekites. The men of Siphmoth received part of what David took back, because they had stood with him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe David shared the spoil with the towns that had sheltered him. Siphmoth gets one line, and I hold that God remembers the places that stood by His anointed.
